# PART A: APPLICATION PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATIONS
> **Audience: WaveMaker Studio Low-Code Developer**
> These issues directly affect end-user speed, mobile responsiveness, and memory usage. Follow the exact Studio steps below to resolve them.

### Duplication & Reuse Opportunities
> Findings below all share the same fix shape: something is defined more than once and should be defined in exactly one place — a Partial, a Prefab-turned-Partial, a shared App.js function, or shared CSS. These are pulled out of Errors/Warnings above because they're structural fixes worth deciding on deliberately, not per-widget nitpicks.

#### Variables/Actions Redefined Per-Page — Promote to App-Level (290)

**[1] Variable 'svPostOrderID' Redefined Identically Across 3 Pages**
- **Where**: `App (Global)`
- 'svPostOrderID' (wm.ServiceVariable) is defined with the exact same configuration independently on 3 separate pages/prefabs (LandingPageSA, pageMultiAssetClass, pageMultiAssetClassDup), instead of once as a shared App-level variable. Each page's copy loads/invokes separately — 3x the network calls for what is functionally one piece of data, and 3x the places to update it.
- → **Move to an App-level Variable/Action**: identical configuration copy-pasted across many pages — one shared definition replaces every page-local copy, cutting redundant network calls and update sites.
- **Studio steps**:
  - Create one App-level Variable with 'svPostOrderID's configuration.
  - Update each of the 3 pages to reference 'App.Variables.svPostOrderID' instead of keeping its own local copy.
  - Delete the 3 redundant page-level copies once every reference is repointed.

### Errors (High Priority)

#### [1] 2 Repeating Widget(s) Nested Inside Another Repeater's Row Template
- **Target Page**: `Datatablemodals`  
- **Problem**: Page 'Datatablemodals' has a Table/List/LiveTable/Tile widget nested inside another repeating widget's row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate). Every row of the outer repeater mounts a full, independent copy of the inner repeating widget — including its own change-detection subtree and its own data fetch if bound to a variable — multiplying DOM nodes and digest cost by (outer rows × inner rows).
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'Datatablemodals'`
  - Identify the inner Table/List/Tile nested inside the outer repeater's row template.
  - Replace it with WaveMaker's Row Detail / row-expansion feature so the inner content is compiled only for the row a user actually expands, instead of for every row.
  - If the inner widget genuinely must render for every row, make sure it's paginated or uses virtual scrolling so it doesn't compound the unbounded-row-count risk.

#### [2] Monolithic Page (1288 widgets)
- **Target Page**: `DialogboxModals`  
- **Problem**: Page 'DialogboxModals' renders 1288 widgets. Pages carrying markup for multiple independent flows (e.g. one page per feature/tab, all rendered at once) compile and enter the digest cycle for every widget at bootstrap, even though only one flow is visible at a time.

  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'DialogboxModals'`
  - Identify independent flows/sections that don't need to be visible simultaneously.

- **Target Page**: `pageAddMifIdProfile`

  - **Location**: `Studio -> Page 'pageAddMifIdProfile' -> Script Tab (JavaScript)`
  - Open Page 'pageAddMifIdProfile' and switch to the Script tab.
  - Store the interval reference on the Page object: 'Page._myInterval = setInterval(...)'
  - Implement 'Page.onPageDestroy' to clear it whenever the user leaves the page:
  ```javascript
Page.onPageDestroy = function () {
    if (Page._myInterval) {
        clearInterval(Page._myInterval);
    }
};
  ```

- **Problem**: Found 'setInterval' on Line 26 in 'partialTicker.js' without a corresponding 'clearInterval' inside 'Page.onPageDestroy'. When users navigate away and return, new intervals stack up, leaking memory and consuming 100% CPU.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio -> Page 'partialTicker' -> Script Tab (JavaScript)`
  - Open Page 'partialTicker' and switch to the Script tab.
  - Store the interval reference on the Page object: 'Page._myInterval = setInterval(...)'
  - Implement 'Page.onPageDestroy' to clear it whenever the user leaves the page:
  ```javascript
Page.onPageDestroy = function () {
    if (Page._myInterval) {
        clearInterval(Page._myInterval);
    }
};
  ```

#### [60] 1 Repeating Widget(s) Nested Inside Another Repeater's Row Template
- **Target Page**: `ErrorNoMatrixCode`  
- **Problem**: Page 'ErrorNoMatrixCode' has a Table/List/LiveTable/Tile widget nested inside another repeating widget's row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate). Every row of the outer repeater mounts a full, independent copy of the inner repeating widget — including its own change-detection subtree and its own data fetch if bound to a variable — multiplying DOM nodes and digest cost by (outer rows × inner rows).
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'ErrorNoMatrixCode'`
  - Identify the inner Table/List/Tile nested inside the outer repeater's row template.
  - Replace it with WaveMaker's Row Detail / row-expansion feature so the inner content is compiled only for the row a user actually expands, instead of for every row.
  - If the inner widget genuinely must render for every row, make sure it's paginated or uses virtual scrolling so it doesn't compound the unbounded-row-count risk.

### Warnings (Medium Priority)

#### [1] 3 Function-Call Binding(s) Inside a Row Template
- **Target Page**: `Common`  
- **Problem**: Page 'Common' has 3 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'Common'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

#### [4] 7 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `Datatablemodals`  
- **Problem**: Page 'Datatablemodals' has 7 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'Datatablemodals'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [14] 1 Conditionally-Shown Prefab(s) Without 'deferload'
- **Target Page**: `InqOnCustRiskProfCatCnfrmation`  
- **Problem**: Page 'InqOnCustRiskProfCatCnfrmation' has 1 <wm-prefab> element(s) that are already conditionally shown (via 'show') but missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually takes effect — the transpiler turns 'show' + 'deferload' into a real deferred-render wrapper, so the prefab won't compile/mount until its 'show' condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'InqOnCustRiskProfCatCnfrmation'`
  - Select each flagged prefab (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [30] 9 Function-Call Binding(s) Inside a Row Template
- **Target Page**: `LandingPageSA`  
- **Problem**: Page 'LandingPageSA' has 9 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'LandingPageSA'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

#### [31] Page Load Variable Waterfall (16 simultaneous calls)
- **Target Page**: `LandingPageSA`  
- **Problem**: Page 'LandingPageSA' triggers 16 variable calls simultaneously upon page initialization (restGopal, serviceVariable1, svGetBondsNontranche, svGetBondsTranche...). This congests the browser's HTTP connection pool.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio -> Page 'LandingPageSA' -> Variables Tab`
  - Review the variables configured on Page 'LandingPageSA'.
  - Keep only the critical above-the-fold variable (e.g. user profile / main summary) on page load.
  - For secondary data (tabs, modals, charts), uncheck 'Request data on page load' and invoke them on demand (e.g. on tab select or button click).

#### [33] 8 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `ModifyBuyBackCorporate`  
- **Problem**: Page 'ModifyBuyBackCorporate' has 8 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'ModifyBuyBackCorporate'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [36] 2 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Loading Eagerly While Inactive
- **Target Page**: `MyTaskPopOver`  
- **Problem**: Page 'MyTaskPopOver' has 2 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that already have a 'show'/'show.bind' condition but are missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually works — the transpiler turns show + deferload into a real deferred-render wrapper, so content compiles/mounts only once the pane's own condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'MyTaskPopOver'`
  - Select each flagged pane (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [68] 8 Function-Call Binding(s) Inside a Row Template
- **Target Page**: `PageOnMFTransfersDetails`  
- **Problem**: Page 'PageOnMFTransfersDetails' has 8 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'PageOnMFTransfersDetails'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

#### [69] Page Load Variable Waterfall (7 simultaneous calls)
- **Target Page**: `PageOnMFTransfersDetails`  
- **Problem**: Page 'PageOnMFTransfersDetails' triggers 7 variable calls simultaneously upon page initialization (svinquiryOnICFGMF, svMFInwardTransferOtherSubmit, svMFOutwardTransferOtherSubmit, svMfTransferVerifySubmit...). This congests the browser's HTTP connection pool.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio -> Page 'PageOnMFTransfersDetails' -> Variables Tab`
  - Review the variables configured on Page 'PageOnMFTransfersDetails'.
  - Keep only the critical above-the-fold variable (e.g. user profile / main summary) on page load.
  - For secondary data (tabs, modals, charts), uncheck 'Request data on page load' and invoke them on demand (e.g. on tab select or button click).

#### [70] 1 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `PageSuccessRelationshipDetails`  
- **Problem**: Page 'PageSuccessRelationshipDetails' has 1 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'PageSuccessRelationshipDetails'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

#### [145] 1 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Loading Eagerly While Inactive

- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:

  - Select each flagged pane (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [146] 3 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pageAddAlternateFund`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageAddAlternateFund' has 3 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageAddAlternateFund'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [148] 6 Function-Call Binding(s) Inside a Row Template
- **Target Page**: `pageAddAlternateFund`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageAddAlternateFund' has 6 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageAddAlternateFund'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageAddMultiAssetClass'`
  - Review whether some dialogs can be consolidated into one shared, parameterized dialog.

#### [226] 62 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pageAddMultiAssetClass`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageAddMultiAssetClass' has 62 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageAddMultiAssetClass'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [227] Excessive DOM Hierarchy (Depth: 21)
- **Target Page**: `pageAddMultiAssetClass`  
- **Problem**: Container elements are nested 21 levels deep on page 'pageAddMultiAssetClass'. Deep DOM hierarchies slow down style calculation and browser rendering.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageAddMultiAssetClass'`
  - Open Page 'pageAddMultiAssetClass' on the Studio canvas.
  - Inspect nested layout containers (wm-layoutgrid -> wm-gridrow -> wm-gridcolumn).
  - Flatten unnecessary wrapper containers by moving child widgets into a single wm-container with flex layout.

#### [228] 22 Function-Call Binding(s) Inside a Row Template
- **Target Page**: `pageAddMultiAssetClass`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageAddMultiAssetClass' has 22 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageAddMultiAssetClass'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

#### [229] Page Load Variable Waterfall (36 simultaneous calls)
- **Target Page**: `pageAddMultiAssetClass`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageAddMultiAssetClass' triggers 36 variable calls simultaneously upon page initialization (svAdditionalDetailsSingleAccount, svOperativeAccountDetails, svPostAdaniPort, svPostAdditionalDetailsSingle...). This congests the browser's HTTP connection pool.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio -> Page 'pageAddMultiAssetClass' -> Variables Tab`
  - Review the variables configured on Page 'pageAddMultiAssetClass'.
  - Keep only the critical above-the-fold variable (e.g. user profile / main summary) on page load.
  - For secondary data (tabs, modals, charts), uncheck 'Request data on page load' and invoke them on demand (e.g. on tab select or button click).

- **Problem**: Page 'pageAddTransferOrdersSuccess' has 24 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageAddTransferOrdersSuccess'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

#### [356] 5 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pageAlternetFundInquireMAClass`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageAlternetFundInquireMAClass' has 5 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageAlternetFundInquireMAClass'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [391] 4 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pageBondsConvertible`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageBondsConvertible' has 4 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageBondsConvertible'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [432] 7 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pageBondsNTRejectEO`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageBondsNTRejectEO' has 7 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageBondsNTRejectEO'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [433] Excessive DOM Hierarchy (Depth: 18)
- **Target Page**: `pageBondsNTRejectEO`  
- **Problem**: Container elements are nested 18 levels deep on page 'pageBondsNTRejectEO'. Deep DOM hierarchies slow down style calculation and browser rendering.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageBondsNTRejectEO'`
  - Open Page 'pageBondsNTRejectEO' on the Studio canvas.
  - Inspect nested layout containers (wm-layoutgrid -> wm-gridrow -> wm-gridcolumn).
  - Flatten unnecessary wrapper containers by moving child widgets into a single wm-container with flex layout.

#### [434] 3 Function-Call Binding(s) Inside a Row Template
- **Target Page**: `pageBondsNTRejectEO`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageBondsNTRejectEO' has 3 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageBondsNTRejectEO'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

#### [443] 3 Conditionally-Shown Prefab(s) Without 'deferload'
- **Target Page**: `pageBondsTInquireEONew`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageBondsTInquireEONew' has 3 <wm-prefab> element(s) that are already conditionally shown (via 'show') but missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually takes effect — the transpiler turns 'show' + 'deferload' into a real deferred-render wrapper, so the prefab won't compile/mount until its 'show' condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageBondsTInquireEONew'`
  - Select each flagged prefab (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [486] 2 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pageCancelBuyback`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageCancelBuyback' has 2 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageCancelBuyback'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [554] 2 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pageDashboardGraphs`

Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageDashboardGraphs'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [563] Page Load Variable Waterfall (6 simultaneous calls)
- **Target Page**: `pageEQCAResponseModify`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageEQCAResponseModify' triggers 6 variable calls simultaneously upon page initialization (svBBCAModifyReferal, svCAModifyReferal, svEQCAModifyReferal, svModifyBOCAResponseDtls...). This congests the browser's HTTP connection pool.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio -> Page 'pageEQCAResponseModify' -> Variables Tab`
  - Review the variables configured on Page 'pageEQCAResponseModify'.
  - Keep only the critical above-the-fold variable (e.g. user profile / main summary) on page load.
  - For secondary data (tabs, modals, charts), uncheck 'Request data on page load' and invoke them on demand (e.g. on tab select or button click).

#### [593] 1 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pageEQVerify`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageEQVerify' has 1 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageEQVerify'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [598] 10 Conditionally-Shown Prefab(s) Without 'deferload'
- **Target Page**: `pageEduCreation`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageEduCreation' has 10 <wm-prefab> element(s) that are already conditionally shown (via 'show') but missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually takes effect — the transpiler turns 'show' + 'deferload' into a real deferred-render wrapper, so the prefab won't compile/mount until its 'show' condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageEduCreation'`
  - Select each flagged prefab (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [630] 3 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Loading Eagerly While Inactive
- **Target Page**: `pageEquityInquire`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageEquityInquire' has 3 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that already have a 'show'/'show.bind' condition but are missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually works — the transpiler turns show + deferload into a real deferred-render wrapper, so content compiles/mounts only once the pane's own condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageEquityInquire'`
  - Select each flagged pane (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [631] 3 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pageEquityInquire`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageEquityInquire' has 3 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageEquityInquire'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [632] Excessive DOM Hierarchy (Depth: 17)
- **Target Page**: `pageEquityInquire`  
- **Problem**: Container elements are nested 17 levels deep on page 'pageEquityInquire'. Deep DOM hierarchies slow down style calculation and browser rendering.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageEquityInquire'`
  - Open Page 'pageEquityInquire' on the Studio canvas.
  - Inspect nested layout containers (wm-layoutgrid -> wm-gridrow -> wm-gridcolumn).
  - Flatten unnecessary wrapper containers by moving child widgets into a single wm-container with flex layout.

#### [633] 8 Function-Call Binding(s) Inside a Row Template
- **Target Page**: `pageEquityInquire`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageEquityInquire' has 8 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageEquityInquire'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

  - Keep only the critical above-the-fold variable (e.g. user profile / main summary) on page load.
  - For secondary data (tabs, modals, charts), uncheck 'Request data on page load' and invoke them on demand (e.g. on tab select or button click).

#### [674] 6 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pageEquityRightIssueResponse`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageEquityRightIssueResponse' has 6 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. - **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageEquityRightIssueResponse'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [710] 8 Function-Call Binding(s) Inside a Row Template
- **Target Page**: `pageFutureReverseModificationEO`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageFutureReverseModificationEO' has 8 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.

  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageFutureReverseModificationEO'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

#### [715] 4 Conditionally-Shown Prefab(s) Without 'deferload'
- **Target Page**: `pageGoalPlanCriteria`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageGoalPlanCriteria' has 4 <wm-prefab> element(s) that are already conditionally shown (via 'show') but missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually takes effect — the transpiler turns 'show' + 'deferload' into a real deferred-render wrapper, so the prefab won't compile/mount until its 'show' condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageGoalPlanCriteria'`
  - Select each flagged prefab (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [756] 3 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Loading Eagerly While Inactive
- **Target Page**: `pageInqMeetingCallReport`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageInqMeetingCallReport' has 3 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that already have a 'show'/'show.bind' condition but are missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually works — the transpiler turns show + deferload into a real deferred-render wrapper, so content compiles/mounts only once the pane's own condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageInqMeetingCallReport'`
  - Select each flagged pane (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [757] 3 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pageInqMeetingCallReport`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageInqMeetingCallReport' has 3 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageInqMeetingCallReport'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [784] 1 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here

#### [851] 1 Conditionally-Shown Prefab(s) Without 'deferload'

#### [853] 1 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pageInqOnSMAV`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageInqOnSMAV' has 1 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageInqOnSMAV'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [972] 22 Conditionally-Shown Prefab(s) Without 'deferload'
- **Target Page**: `pageMFModifyEO`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageMFModifyEO' has 22 <wm-prefab> element(s) that are already conditionally shown (via 'show') but missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually takes effect — the transpiler turns 'show' + 'deferload' into a real deferred-render wrapper, so the prefab won't compile/mount until its 'show' condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageMFModifyEO'`
  - Select each flagged prefab (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

Adding it here actually works — the transpiler turns show + deferload into a real deferred-render wrapper, so content compiles/mounts only once the pane's own condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:

  - Select each flagged pane (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [1006] 7 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pageModify`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageModify' has 7 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageModify'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [1008] 5 Function-Call Binding(s) Inside a Row Template
- **Target Page**: `pageModify`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageModify' has 5 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageModify'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

#### [1086] 26 Conditionally-Shown Prefab(s) Without 'deferload'
- **Target Page**: `pageModifyRetailProspect`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageModifyRetailProspect' has 26 <wm-prefab> element(s) that are already conditionally shown (via 'show') but missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually takes effect — the transpiler turns 'show' + 'deferload' into a real deferred-render wrapper, so the prefab won't compile/mount until its 'show' condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageModifyRetailProspect'`
  - Select each flagged prefab (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [1087] 4 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Loading Eagerly While Inactive
- **Target Page**: `pageModifyRetailProspect`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageModifyRetailProspect' has 4 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that already have a 'show'/'show.bind' condition but are missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually works — the transpiler turns show + deferload into a real deferred-render wrapper, so content compiles/mounts only once the pane's own condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageModifyRetailProspect'`
  - Select each flagged pane (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [1088] 21 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pageModifyRetailProspect`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageModifyRetailProspect' has 21 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageModifyRetailProspect'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [1089] Excessive DOM Hierarchy (Depth: 26)
- **Target Page**: `pageModifyRetailProspect`

  - Open Page 'pageModifyRetailProspect' on the Studio canvas.
  - Inspect nested layout containers (wm-layoutgrid -> wm-gridrow -> wm-gridcolumn).
  - Flatten unnecessary wrapper containers by moving child widgets into a single wm-container with flex layout.

#### [1090] 6 Function-Call Binding(s) Inside a Row Template
- **Target Page**: `pageModifyRetailProspect`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageModifyRetailProspect' has 6 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageModifyRetailProspect'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

- **Problem**: Page 'pageMultipleAcMultiBond' has 6 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageMultipleAcMultiBond'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [1127] Excessive DOM Hierarchy (Depth: 22)
- **Target Page**: `pageMultipleAcMultiBond`  
- **Problem**: Container elements are nested 22 levels deep on page 'pageMultipleAcMultiBond'. Deep DOM hierarchies slow down style calculation and browser rendering.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageMultipleAcMultiBond'`
  - Open Page 'pageMultipleAcMultiBond' on the Studio canvas.
  - Inspect nested layout containers (wm-layoutgrid -> wm-gridrow -> wm-gridcolumn).
  - Flatten unnecessary wrapper containers by moving child widgets into a single wm-container with flex layout.

#### [1128] 2 Function-Call Binding(s) Inside a Row Template
- **Target Page**: `pageMultipleAcMultiBond`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageMultipleAcMultiBond' has 2 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageMultipleAcMultiBond'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

#### [1146] 4 Conditionally-Shown Prefab(s) Without 'deferload'
- **Target Page**: `pageOnGenEqOrderTrack`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageOnGenEqOrderTrack' has 4 <wm-prefab> element(s) that are already conditionally shown (via 'show') but missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually takes effect — the transpiler turns 'show' + 'deferload' into a real deferred-render wrapper, so the prefab won't compile/mount until its 'show' condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageOnGenEqOrderTrack'`
  - Select each flagged prefab (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [1150] Page Load Variable Waterfall (10 simultaneous calls)
- **Target Page**: `pageOnTransfers`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageOnTransfers' triggers 10 variable calls simultaneously upon page initialization (postWMSInvestIdInq, svEquityTransferOtherFetch, svFetchWMSMFSubDtlsInq, svInwardTransferAddFetch...). This congests the browser's HTTP connection pool.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio -> Page 'pageOnTransfers' -> Variables Tab`
  - Review the variables configured on Page 'pageOnTransfers'.
  - Keep only the critical above-the-fold variable (e.g. user profile / main summary) on page load.
  - For secondary data (tabs, modals, charts), uncheck 'Request data on page load' and invoke them on demand (e.g. on tab select or button click).

#### [1166] 1 Conditionally-Shown Prefab(s) Without 'deferload'
- **Target Page**: `pageOrderInbox`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageOrderInbox' has 1 <wm-prefab> element(s) that are already conditionally shown (via 'show') but missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually takes effect — the transpiler turns 'show' + 'deferload' into a real deferred-render wrapper, so the prefab won't compile/mount until its 'show' condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageOrderInbox'`
  - Select each flagged prefab (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [1167] 13 Function-Call Binding(s) Inside a Row Template
- **Target Page**: `pageOrderInbox`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageOrderInbox' has 13 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageOrderInbox'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

#### [1168] Page Load Variable Waterfall (10 simultaneous calls)
- **Target Page**: `pageOrderInbox`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageOrderInbox' triggers 10 variable calls simultaneously upon page initialization (svINSNewRenewTranVerCancelRq, svPETranDtlsSubmit, svpostIPOCodeFetch, svpostWMSOrderInboxInq...). This congests the browser's HTTP connection pool.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio -> Page 'pageOrderInbox' -> Variables Tab`
  - Review the variables configured on Page 'pageOrderInbox'.
  - Keep only the critical above-the-fold variable (e.g. user profile / main summary) on page load.
  - For secondary data (tabs, modals, charts), uncheck 'Request data on page load' and invoke them on demand (e.g. on tab select or button click).

#### [1172] 7 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pageOrdersIPOWalkinCustomer`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageOrdersIPOWalkinCustomer' has 7 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageOrdersIPOWalkinCustomer'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [1207] 1 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Loading Eagerly While Inactive
- **Target Page**: `pagePMModifyEO`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pagePMModifyEO' has 1 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that already have a 'show'/'show.bind' condition but are missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually works — the transpiler turns show + deferload into a real deferred-render wrapper, so content compiles/mounts only once the pane's own condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pagePMModifyEO'`
  - Select each flagged pane (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [1208] 3 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pagePMModifyEO`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pagePMModifyEO' has 3 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pagePMModifyEO'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [1242] 6 Function-Call Binding(s) Inside a Row Template
- **Target Page**: `pageQuickOnboardingbackup`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageQuickOnboardingbackup' has 6 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageQuickOnboardingbackup'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

#### [1243] 10 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pageReactiveRelationship`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageReactiveRelationship' has 10 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageReactiveRelationship'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [1264] Page Load Variable Waterfall (12 simultaneous calls)

  - Keep only the critical above-the-fold variable (e.g. user profile / main summary) on page load.
  - For secondary data (tabs, modals, charts), uncheck 'Request data on page load' and invoke them on demand (e.g. on tab select or button click).

#### [1269] 18 Conditionally-Shown Prefab(s) Without 'deferload'
- **Target Page**: `pageRegisterCorpProspect`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageRegisterCorpProspect' has 18 <wm-prefab> element(s) that are already conditionally shown (via 'show') but missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually takes effect — the transpiler turns 'show' + 'deferload' into a real deferred-render wrapper, so the prefab won't compile/mount until its 'show' condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageRegisterCorpProspect'`
  - Select each flagged prefab (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [1283] 4 Function-Call Binding(s) Inside a Row Template
- **Target Page**: `pageRelQuickOnboarding`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageRelQuickOnboarding' has 4 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageRelQuickOnboarding'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

#### [1322] 1 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Loading Eagerly While Inactive
- **Target Page**: `pageSPVerifyEO`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageSPVerifyEO' has 1 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that already have a 'show'/'show.bind' condition but are missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually works — the transpiler turns show + deferload into a real deferred-render wrapper, so content compiles/mounts only once the pane's own condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageSPVerifyEO'`
  - Select each flagged pane (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [1323] 5 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pageSPVerifyEO`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageSPVerifyEO' has 5 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageSPVerifyEO'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [1365] 1 Conditionally-Shown Prefab(s) Without 'deferload'
- **Target Page**: `pageSuccessPortfolioMgmt`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageSuccessPortfolioMgmt' has 1 <wm-prefab> element(s) that are already conditionally shown (via 'show') but missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually takes effect — the transpiler turns 'show' + 'deferload' into a real deferred-render wrapper, so the prefab won't compile/mount until its 'show' condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageSuccessPortfolioMgmt'`
  - Select each flagged prefab (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [1366] 4 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pageSuccessPortfolioMgmt`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageSuccessPortfolioMgmt' has 4 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageSuccessPortfolioMgmt'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [1373] 20 Function-Call Binding(s) Inside a Row Template
- **Target Page**: `pageSuccessSA`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageSuccessSA' has 20 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageSuccessSA'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

#### [1422] Page Load Variable Waterfall (9 simultaneous calls)

  - For secondary data (tabs, modals, charts), uncheck 'Request data on page load' and invoke them on demand (e.g. on tab select or button click).

#### [1440] 2 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `pageViewProtectionGoal`  
- **Problem**: Page 'pageViewProtectionGoal' has 2 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'pageViewProtectionGoal'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [1442] Page Load Variable Waterfall (10 simultaneous calls)

  - Keep only the critical above-the-fold variable (e.g. user profile / main summary) on page load.
  - For secondary data (tabs, modals, charts), uncheck 'Request data on page load' and invoke them on demand (e.g. on tab select or button click).

#### [1531] 1 Conditionally-Shown Prefab(s) Without 'deferload'

  - Select each flagged prefab (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [1554] Page Load Variable Waterfall (6 simultaneous calls)

  - Review the variables configured on Page 'partialInvestorNotifications'.
  - Keep only the critical above-the-fold variable (e.g. user profile / main summary) on page load.

#### [1555] 1 Conditionally-Shown Prefab(s) Without 'deferload'
- **Target Page**: `partialInvstFinancialModuleAllow`  
- **Problem**: Page 'partialInvstFinancialModuleAllow' has 1 <wm-prefab> element(s) that are already conditionally shown (via 'show') but missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually takes effect — the transpiler turns 'show' + 'deferload' into a real deferred-render wrapper, so the prefab won't compile/mount until its 'show' condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'partialInvstFinancialModuleAllow'`
  - Select each flagged prefab (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'partialParticipantDetails'`
  - Select each flagged prefab (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [1591] 12 Function-Call Binding(s) Inside a Row Template
- **Target Page**: `partialPortfolioPerformance`  
- **Problem**: Page 'partialPortfolioPerformance' has 12 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'partialPortfolioPerformance'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

#### [1599] 2 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `partialProspectNotifications`  
- **Problem**: Page 'partialProspectNotifications' has 2 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'partialProspectNotifications'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [1602] Page Load Variable Waterfall (6 simultaneous calls)
- **Target Page**: `partialProspectNotifications`  
- **Problem**: Page 'partialProspectNotifications' triggers 6 variable calls simultaneously upon page initialization (svCallReportFetchProspect, svCallReportUpdateRes, svSubmitFpsUpdateTaskRes, svSubmitFpsUpdateTodoWidRequestRes...). This congests the browser's HTTP connection pool.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio -> Page 'partialProspectNotifications' -> Variables Tab`
  - Review the variables configured on Page 'partialProspectNotifications'.
  - Keep only the critical above-the-fold variable (e.g. user profile / main summary) on page load.
  - For secondary data (tabs, modals, charts), uncheck 'Request data on page load' and invoke them on demand (e.g. on tab select or button click).

- **Problem**: Page 'partialRelExpenseRevRelationship' has 1 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'partialRelExpenseRevRelationship'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [1626] 3 Conditionally-Shown Prefab(s) Without 'deferload'
- **Target Page**: `partialRelIncomeModify`  
- **Problem**: Page 'partialRelIncomeModify' has 3 <wm-prefab> element(s) that are already conditionally shown (via 'show') but missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually takes effect — the transpiler turns 'show' + 'deferload' into a real deferred-render wrapper, so the prefab won't compile/mount until its 'show' condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'partialRelIncomeModify'`
  - Select each flagged prefab (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [1653] 3 Function-Call Binding(s) Inside a Row Template
- **Target Page**: `partialRelationshipCustComm`  
- **Problem**: Page 'partialRelationshipCustComm' has 3 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'partialRelationshipCustComm'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

- **Problem**: Page 'EquityTransferAdditionalDetails' has 1 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'EquityTransferAdditionalDetails'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

#### [1773] 3 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `Equity_Additional_Details`  
- **Problem**: Page 'Equity_Additional_Details' has 3 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'Equity_Additional_Details'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [1775] 2 Conditionally-Shown Prefab(s) Without 'deferload'
- **Target Page**: `Exchange_Code`  
- **Problem**: Page 'Exchange_Code' has 2 <wm-prefab> element(s) that are already conditionally shown (via 'show') but missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually takes effect — the transpiler turns 'show' + 'deferload' into a real deferred-render wrapper, so the prefab won't compile/mount until its 'show' condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'Exchange_Code'`
  - Select each flagged prefab (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [1808] 16 Function-Call Binding(s) Inside a Row Template
- **Target Page**: `Investor_Detail`  
- **Problem**: Page 'Investor_Detail' has 16 'bind:' expression(s) containing a function call inside a Table/List/Tile row template. Angular re-evaluates every binding on each change-detection cycle — inside a row template that means the function runs once per visible row, per digest, not once per page.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'Investor_Detail'`
  - Open the row/item template (wm-table-column, wm-listtemplate, or wm-tiletemplate) and find the 'bind:' expression calling a function.
  - Precompute the value once (e.g. on the variable's dataSet, or in Page.onLoad/on the variable's success handler) and bind to that plain property instead of calling the function from the template.

#### [1809] 5 Tab/Wizard/Accordion Pane(s) Load Eagerly, and 'deferload' Won't Help Here
- **Target Page**: `Investor_Details`  
- **Problem**: Page 'Investor_Details' has 5 tab pane / wizard step / accordion pane element(s) that compile and fire any auto-loading variable immediately, even though they aren't shown by default. Unlike the case above, these panes have no 'show'/'show.bind' condition, so 'deferload="true"' has nothing to attach to and won't defer anything on its own.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'Investor_Details'`
  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [1812] 10 Conditionally-Shown Prefab(s) Without 'deferload'
- **Target Page**: `InwardTransfersAdditionalDetails`  
- **Problem**: Page 'InwardTransfersAdditionalDetails' has 10 <wm-prefab> element(s) that are already conditionally shown (via 'show') but missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually takes effect — the transpiler turns 'show' + 'deferload' into a real deferred-render wrapper, so the prefab won't compile/mount until its 'show' condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'InwardTransfersAdditionalDetails'`
  - Select each flagged prefab (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

  - For each variable bound inside these panes, turn off 'Auto Update'/'Update on Page load' in its Behavior settings.
  - Instead, invoke that variable manually from the pane's 'On Select'/'On Expand' event, so it only fires once the user actually opens that tab/step/pane.

#### [2034] 2 Conditionally-Shown Prefab(s) Without 'deferload'
- **Target Page**: `structuresOrderId`  
- **Problem**: Page 'structuresOrderId' has 2 <wm-prefab> element(s) that are already conditionally shown (via 'show') but missing 'deferload="true"'. Adding it here actually takes effect — the transpiler turns 'show' + 'deferload' into a real deferred-render wrapper, so the prefab won't compile/mount until its 'show' condition becomes true.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Studio Canvas -> Page 'structuresOrderId'`
  - Select each flagged prefab (already bound to 'show').
  - In the Properties Panel, enable 'Defer Load' (deferload) alongside the existing 'show' condition.

#### [2073] 4 Render-Blocking Stylesheet(s) in index.html
- **Target Page**: `App (Global)`  
- **Problem**: index.html links 4 stylesheet(s) that block rendering until they download (_cdnUrl_/wmapp/styles/css/wm-style.css, _cdnUrl_/wmapp/styles/css/wm-responsive.css, themes/_activeTheme_/style.css, app.css). This is often correct (core theme/app CSS genuinely needs to apply before first paint to avoid a flash of unstyled content) — reported for review, not asserted as a bug, since telling which of these are safe to deprioritize requires knowing what's actually needed above the fold.
- **WaveMaker Studio UI Fix**:
  - **Location**: `Project -> index.html`
  - Review whether every stylesheet listed is genuinely needed before first paint.
  - For any that aren't (e.g. below-the-fold-only styling), consider the preload+swap pattern: <link rel="preload" href="..." as="style" onload="this.onload=null;this.rel='stylesheet'"> with a <noscript> fallback — but confirm this doesn't cause a visible flash of unstyled content and isn't blocked by CSP before adopting it.

# PART B: BUILD & DEPLOYMENT RESOURCE OPTIMIZATIONS
> **Audience: DevOps, Platform Engineers, and Build Administrators**
> Reducing production build RAM/CPU usage and preventing Out-of-Memory (OOM) crashes.

### Build Resource Auto-Patches Applied

| Resource Area | Why It Matters | Auto-Patcher Remediation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Vendor Source Maps** | Generates full source-maps for node_modules during the production build. | [OK] Set `sourceMap.vendor: false` in `angular.json`. Effect on peak build RAM not independently verified — treat as hygiene, not a guaranteed RAM reduction. |
| **License Extraction** | Scans every bundled module's source for license banners to assemble `3rdpartylicenses.txt`, while the compiler already holds the full module graph in memory. | [OK] Set `extractLicenses: false` in `angular.json`. Cheap and harmless; effect on peak build RAM not independently verified. |
| **Unused Global Scripts** | Heavy third-party scripts (D3, Summernote, zTree) loaded globally regardless of usage. | [OK] Pruned unreferenced libraries from `angular.json` scripts. |
| **Node VM Memory Cap** | A memory limit set below the build's actual peak RSS causes an out-of-memory crash, not a graceful slowdown. | [ACTION] Set `--max-old-space-size` to this project's own **Recommended Safe Node Memory Limit** above (only available when a real `monitor` run has measured this project) — never a generic fixed number. |

Large WaveMaker apps can have a substantial *fixed* build-memory floor — driven by the compiler/bundler's own handling of the shared framework surface, not by how much page-specific code exists — that none of the patches above can reduce. If a project's peak RSS is still high after these patches, provisioning the build machine for the actually-measured peak (via a real `monitor` run) is the reliable fix, not further config tuning.

### Unused Global Libraries Eligible for Pruning

The following libraries are included in the project but are never used by any page:

- **Summernote RichText Editor** (`summernote/dist/summernote-lite.min.js`): injected unconditionally on every page load — **~220 KB unminified bundle savings** at runtime if pruned
- **zTree Library** (`@ztree/ztree_v3/js/jquery.ztree.all.js`): injected unconditionally on every page load — **~140 KB unminified bundle savings** at runtime if pruned
